title: Header map replacement loses caller-visible mutations
claim: Eager tainting replaces the request Header map after WithContext clones the request, so handler header mutations no longer reach aliases held by the caller; the plain handler preserves this side effect.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go test -timeout 12m -count=1 -run ^TestReview_ -v ./iast/net/http

title: Replaced URL query is falsely attributed to the request
claim: URL.Query lazily taints all results from the bound URL even after the application replaces RawQuery with a trusted literal, falsely labeling that literal as an HTTP parameter.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go test -timeout 12m -count=1 -run ^TestReview_ -v ./iast/net/http
